name: Immersar
summary: This game-like experience invites users to explore intricate cyberpunk cityscapes and ethereal space scenes, each environment synchronized with the album’s dynamic soundscapes. Through the seamless integration of interactive VR features, Immersar pushes the boundaries of how music is experienced, transforming sound into a fully immersive 3D world, breaking free from traditional formats and redefining the way we connect with music in the digital age.
